question: Should OpenClaw add public persisted rootSessionKey and session-chain traceId fields for spawned sessions, and should traceId be a new chain identifier or map to existing diagnostic trace context?
rationale: The implementation shape is bounded, but these fields become durable persisted session and Gateway/tool API contracts whose semantics need maintainer ownership before another fix PR is useful.

options.title: Add Minimal Spawn-Chain Contract
options.body: Add optional parent/root/trace/depth metadata for spawned sessions only, with additive schemas, projections, docs, and tests while leaving traversal APIs for later.

options.title: Align With Resolver Lineage First
options.body: Keep this open until sessions.resolve and rotated-family lineage semantics settle, then align spawned-session metadata with that broader contract.

options.title: Reject Durable Root/Trace Fields
options.body: Keep current parent/depth behavior and limit future work to tooling, docs, or non-persisted diagnostics if maintainers do not want a new chain identifier.

recommendation.title: Add Minimal Spawn-Chain Contract
recommendation.body: Add optional parent/root/trace/depth metadata for spawned sessions only, with additive schemas, projections, docs, and tests while leaving traversal APIs for later.
